title: Thermodynamic formalism for intermittent maps with multiple neutral fixed points and phase transitions
summary: In this paper, we develop the thermodynamic formalism for intermittent full-branch interval maps with finitely many neutral fixed points and for a broad class of possibly discontinuous potentials. Under a hyperbolicity assumption on the potential, we prove the existence of a unique equilibrium state with positive entropy and exponential decay of correlations.
